    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let B := fun y => Finset.univ.image (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
    (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y)
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    apply (Finset.card_le_card (t := Y.toFinset.biUnion B) ?_).trans
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : f x ≠ g x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx'⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps x,
        Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl
    · apply Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans
      calc
        ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, (B y).card ≤ ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro y hy
          exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin _)
        _ = _ := by simp
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    rw [hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    have h := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcard)
    rw [←mul_assoc] at h
    have h' := h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb)
    rw [hid] at h'
    have hp : 0 < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
      unfold BBF_CodeDistance
      omega
    omega
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact_mod_cast hnat

    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)

  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let B := fun (y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) => Finset.univ.image (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
    (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y)
  letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card (t := Y.toFinset.biUnion B) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : f x ≠ g x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let B := fun (y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) => Finset.univ.image (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
    (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y)
  letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card (t := Y.toFinset.biUnion B) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : f x ≠ g.val x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx'⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps x,
        Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl
    · apply Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans
      calc
        ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, (B y).card ≤ ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro y hy
          exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin _)
        _ = _ := by simp
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    change 2 * (↑(sInf S) : ℕ∞) < _ at h_fw_dist_lt
    rw [←hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    have h := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcard)
    rw [←mul_assoc] at h
    have h' := h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb)
    rw [hid] at h'
    have hp : 0 < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
      unfold BBF_CodeDistance
      omega
    omega
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact_mod_cast hnat

  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ

  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g

  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card (t := Y.toFinset.biUnion B) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : f x ≠ g.val x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx'⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps x,

      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl

          intro y hy

  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    change 2 * (↑(sInf S) : ℕ∞) < _ at h_fw_dist_lt
    rw [←hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    have h := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcard)
    rw [←mul_assoc] at h

    have hp : 0 < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by

  exact_mod_cast hnat

    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)

    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let j : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let k : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩
  have hi := fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) j
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, hi⟩
    steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card
      (t := (Y.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (Function.uncurry Q)) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(y, pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β j steps h_i_add_steps x),
        Finset.mk_mem_product (Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)

    · exact Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq (by

    rw [←hg] at h_fw_dist_lt

  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 k - 1) * 2 ^ steps =

    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]

      (h2 := h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), Nat.add_sub_cancel,

        (h2 := h_i_add_steps), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j := by

  exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 hnat

    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)

    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let j : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) j
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg_mem⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := S)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩
    steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (s := Y.toFinite.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ)
      (Function.uncurry Q) ?_).trans_eq ?_
    · intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x

        Finset.mk_mem_product (Y.toFinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
          (Finset.mem_univ _), ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl

    steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)

    refine (Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (s := Y.toFinite.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ)
      (Function.uncurry Q) ?_).trans_eq ?_
    · intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x

          (Finset.mem_univ _), ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl

    (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 hnat)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let j : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) j
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg_mem⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := S)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩
    steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (s := Y.toFinite.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ)
      (Function.uncurry Q) ?_).trans_eq ?_
    · intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine ⟨(y, pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β j steps h_i_add_steps x),
        Finset.mk_mem_product (Y.toFinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
          (Finset.mem_univ _), ?_⟩
      dsimp only [Function.uncurry]
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl
    · simp only [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1 := by
    change 2 * (↑(sInf S) : ℕ∞) < _ at h_fw_dist_lt
    rw [←hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one] at h
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq,
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))),
      Nat.sub_add_eq, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps), mul_assoc] at h
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcard).trans h)
  unfold hammingClose
  exact ((ENat.mul_le_mul_left_iff (a := 2) (by decide) (by decide)).2
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f (C := C) g hg_mem)).trans_lt
    (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 hnat)

      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
